title: Self-standing porous intermetallic Fe3Mn7 phase as a bifunctional electrocatalyst towards efficient overall water splitting
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6SE00159A, Paper
Yan Wen, Yu Cao, Yufei Ren, Zhen Huo
Dealloying-derived self-standing intermetallic Fe3Mn7 possesses a porous-ligament structure with ultra-large specific surface area, exhibiting superior electrocatalytic activity towards alkaline HER, OER and industrial water electrolysis.
